name: 伊珂涅
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_一_探井的年月.md:3136
who: Ikone Whalepipe, a deep-tide demon-kin woman from a family of sea-beast herders, who in the year 77 turned a winter tide of hundreds of sea beasts back out of the salt gate with a bone whistle, and has looked about twenty-two ever since; thirty-seven in that year: about 176 cm, tall, long-limbed and strong from riding beasts through the waves. Two fine gill slits behind each ear that close flat out of the water. Small silver-blue scales along both sides of her neck and down the outer sides of her legs. Long wavy deep ink-violet hair with a sea-blue sheen, tied low in a loose braid. Pale silver-gold eyes like sunlight seen from under water. Fair skin with a faint cool sheen. No earrings, no other jewellery. Chatty and warm with beasts and newcomers; when it is urgent she says one or two words.
build: 176 cm, tall and long-limbed: strong shoulders and back from riding, an F-cup, a narrow waist and full, rounded hips.
palette: deep ink-violet and sea blue, pale silver-gold, silver-blue scale, salt white, dark kelp brown
casual: Her sea-beast herder's clothes: a fitted dark kelp-brown oiled-leather riding jacket closing down the front with bone toggles, cut short in the body so it will not drag in the water, over a salt-white linen shirt; close-fitting dark sea-green breeches and soft sealskin boots to the knee; a coil of thin beast-line at her belt. She holds the long pale bone herding whistle near her lips in one hand, the other hand held out low and open as if letting a beast smell it, a warm, coaxing look.
private: After the herd is in: a loose long-sleeved undyed wool sweater, a dark wool skirt to the shins, bare feet, the ink-violet braid let loose and still damp. She holds a small wooden bucket of fish against her hip, a cheerful, talkative look.
battle: Turning the winter tide at the salt gate, in a deep-tide herder's sea-riding harness: a fitted vest of dark sea-beast hide with an oily blue-green sheen over the riding jacket; pale ribbed shell plates cut from a shallow-water beast strapped at both shoulders and down the outer forearms, their edges traced with sea-green wave runes that glow like light through water; a soft hide gorget that leaves the gill slits free; a broad belt hung with coils of beast-line ending in faintly glowing bone toggles; sealskin riding boots with shell greaves. She holds the long bone whistle to her lips with both hands, rings of pale sea-green light spreading from its mouth, the braid flying, the silver-gold eyes fierce and fixed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: tense and ready, the feet a little wider and planted, both hands holding the long bone whistle to her lips, rings of pale sea-green light spreading from it, a fierce, fixed look; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day the two white salt dikes were named: a long deep sea-blue wool dress closing down the front with small bone buttons, fitted sleeves, a short salt-white shawl knotted at the chest, the braid pinned up with a shell comb, soft boots; the bone whistle on a cord at her chest. She stands upright with the hands folded in front, a shy, pleased look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the silver-gold eyes looking out past the viewer, the bone whistle at her lips, wind and spray lifting the ink-violet braid, the gill slits behind her ear just open. Cold grey winter-sea light from one side, a pale ring of white water glowing behind her like a turning gate. Foreground blur: flying salt spray, the wet curve of a great sea beast's back and a few silver-blue glints of scale.
gear: 极境（77年凝名那一回）｜中｜照常（不拿刀枪）｜3档｜77年寒星月名字凝住时还在极境，定第三档；赶海兽的人家有自己的兽，算中等，不加减。她引兽靠骨哨，不拿兵器，甲照骑兽下水的路子做：海兽皮背心、浅水兽的壳片肩甲护臂，护喉不压鳃，招牌是骨哨。

name: 卡隆瓦
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_一_探井的年月.md:3144
who: Karonva Inkscale, a dragonborn of the ink-scale line from the cliffs on the southern slope of the Dragon-sleep Spine, who in the year 89 took nine days of lightning into himself on the cliff top to save the houses below, and has looked about twenty-five ever since; thirty-one in that year: about 203 cm, very tall, long-limbed, lean and strong. Two short horns at the temples slanting back. Glossy ink-black scales over the back of the neck, the shoulders and both arms, and in the seams between the scales fine white lightning veins branching from the throat down to every fingertip. Short tousled hair of pale storm-blue between the horns, a few strands always standing up as if charged. Deep storm-grey eyes with thin vertical slit pupils, each pupil ringed in pale gold. Where there are no scales his skin is fair with a cool tint. Earnest and warm, quiet until birds come up, then he talks from morning to afternoon. He has TWO short horns, one at EACH temple, each no longer than a hand, both clearly visible and mirror-matched, slanting back; never draw only one horn, never long curling horns. The pupils are thin black vertical slits like a lizard's, never round, each ringed in pale gold.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dragonborn man's face of about twenty-five, long and earnest, NOT old: deep storm-grey eyes with thin black vertical slit pupils like a lizard's, a thin pale gold ring round each pupil; the face itself bare fair skin with no scales, the ink-black scales beginning at the back of the neck and the sides of the throat; fine white lightning veins climbing from the throat to the jaw line. Skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 203 cm, very tall and long-limbed: broad but lean shoulders, long strong arms, a narrow waist.
palette: ink-black scale, lightning white, pale storm blue, storm grey, pale gold, slate grey wool
casual: His thunder-road escort clothes: a long slate-grey wool coat with the sleeves cut off above the elbow to bare the scaled forearms, closing down the front with horn toggles, over a dark linen shirt; a broad leather belt, dark trousers and heavy hobnailed mountain boots; a battered leather drawing tube of bird sketches slung across his back. In his right hand a tall iron-shod staff with a copper spike at its foot, which he drives into rock to ground the lightning. He looks up past the viewer as if at a bird, an eager, open look.
private: At home on the cliff: a loose undyed wool sweater with the sleeves pushed up, dark trousers, soft boots. He holds a sheet of paper with a bird drawn on it in one hand and a stick of charcoal in the other, a delighted, talkative look.
battle: Taking the lightning on the cliff top, in old gear refitted for the mountain: a sleeveless ink-black scale-plate vest of old dragonborn make, re-laced over the dark linen shirt, its plates riveted with copper studs that glow white with caught lightning; a single heavy copper-ringed pauldron salvaged and refitted on the left shoulder (on the viewer's right when he faces us); copper grounding chains wound round both forearms and hanging from the wrists; the coat thrown off, the scaled arms bare to the shoulder; the hobnailed boots. Both hands grip the tall iron-shod staff held upright before him, a bolt of white lightning pouring into his raised arms and branching along every white vein between his scales, the slit eyes blazing pale gold, the jaw clenched.
formal: At the cliff's feast after the storm: a long dark slate wool coat with a stand collar, closing down the front with horn buttons, fitted sleeves, a narrow white sash, dark trousers and polished boots. He stands upright with the hands folded in front, a shy, earnest look.
art: A portrait from below with the camera tilted, the face large, the gold-ringed slit eyes looking up into a storm, the white lightning veins lit along his throat and jaw. Cold white lightning light from above on one side, deep storm blue on the other. Foreground blur: falling rain, a loose bird sketch fluttering and a few shed black scales.
gear: 极境（89年凝名那一回）｜贫｜照常｜2档｜那九天他还在极境，底子三档；墨鳞崖上几十户老人孩子，家境穷，降一档。身上的黑鳞本来就是护甲，加一件改合身的旧鳞片背心、一边捡来的肩甲，前臂缠铜的接地链；手里的铁头杖是起的（★），接地用，页上写他离了接地的岩撑不久。

name: 库妮贡德·斯滕
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_一_探井的年月.md:3128
who: Kunigunde Sten, a human of the Sten family who keep a breach in the middle stretch of the Long Wall, who in the year 61 held up the sinking keystone of an old culvert with her own back for three days and three nights, and has looked thirty-two ever since: about 169 cm, broad and solid in the shoulders and back. Long deep auburn hair, a warm red-brown, in a single thick braid lying against the back of her neck. Clear spring-green eyes. On her right shoulder a pale stone-grain mark like veined marble, left from those three nights (on the viewer's left when she faces us). Fair skin. No earrings, no other jewellery. Warm, practical and eager; she always asks whether you have tested it, and when it is urgent she first says which stone is moving.
build: 169 cm, broad and solid: strong shoulders and back, a D-cup, a firm waist and full, rounded hips.
palette: deep auburn, spring green, wall grey, pale stone white, warm gold-white light
casual: Her wall-mender's clothes: an undyed linen work shirt with the right sleeve cut away at the shoulder so the pale stone-grain mark shows (on the viewer's left when she faces us), the left sleeve rolled to the elbow; a sleeveless wall-grey wool jerkin laced up the front; a broad leather belt with a mason's trowel in a loop; dark wool trousers and heavy patched boots; a long coil of rope over her left shoulder. She holds a stone hammer loosely in her right hand, a bright, eager look.
private: A long-sleeved soft green wool dress to the shins, a knitted brown shawl, soft shoes, the braid over one shoulder. She holds a folded, water-stained old drawing of a high bridge with a row of tiny figures on it, half of it washed away, a wistful smile.
battle: Holding up the keystone, in the Sten family's handed-down wall harness: a fitted breastplate and back plate of old enchanted wall steel engraved with the Sten stone-course pattern, its grooves glowing soft white, laced over the linen shirt; a single heavy steel pauldron on the left shoulder, the right shoulder left bare so the stone-grain mark shows; rune-etched steel vambraces with a small lit crystal at each wrist; tassets of the same steel over dark trousers; the long rope coiled at her hip. Both arms are raised high with the palms pushed flat upward as if holding a great stone, a broad arch of gold-white light spreading from her back and shoulders, its stone-grain lines joining the mark on her shoulder, the jaw set, the green eyes fierce.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced like a pillar, the feet wide and planted, both arms raised high with the palms pushed flat upward as if holding up a great stone, a broad arch of gold-white light behind her back; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the day the culvert was named: a long deep green wool dress closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, a short wall-grey cape pinned at the throat with a plain bronze clasp stamped with the Sten stone-course mark, the braid tied with a green ribbon, polished boots. She stands upright with the hands folded in front, a slightly awkward, pleased smile.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the green eyes looking up at something heavy overhead, a smear of grit on one cheek, the braid fallen over the shoulder. A warm gold-white glow rising behind her on one side, deep underground darkness on the other. Foreground blur: falling grit and stone dust, a coil of rope and splashing dark water.
gear: 英雄（61年凝名那一回）→约95年传奇｜中｜照常（不靠兵器）｜4档｜第三格画的是暗河上的拱那三夜，她那时在英雄，英雄不看家境，用斯滕家传下来的墙甲（照山铜纪拿剑的那一身的家纹写法）；她靠背顶，不拿兵器，右肩空着露出石纹，背后一道金白的光拱。

name: 扎希尔
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_一_探井的年月.md:3094
who: Zahir, called Horn's End, a fire-horn demon-kin who in about 838 drove a flood of molten rock back into its cavern with the fire of his own horns for three days, and has looked about thirty ever since; a legend, a hundred and fifty-eight in the year 2: about 193 cm, deep in the chest and back, narrow at the waist. Short-cropped red-gold hair. Bright clear yellow eyes. Where his long black-red horns once swept back there are only two blunt blackened stumps on his brow. Dark red flame patterns run over both arms. Skin of a warm reddish fire-horn hue. Never without a small clay cup chipped at one corner of the rim. No jewellery. Plain and warm; he asks whether you are cold or have eaten before anything else, and his low laugh sounds like a drum knocked twice through a wall.
build: 193 cm, deep in the chest and back, a narrow waist, strong arms.
palette: red-gold, bright yellow, charred black, ember red, fired-clay ochre
casual: His canal-worker's clothes: a heavy fire-proof sleeveless vest of thick felted wool faced with dull scorched leather, broad across the shoulders and laced up the front, over bare arms showing the dark red flame patterns; an old worn leather belt; loose dark brown work trousers tucked into heavy hobnailed boots. In his left palm the small clay cup with the chipped rim, in his right palm a tiny carved bone dragon with very small wings, just taken out of the cup. A warm, low-laughing look.
private: Making painted pottery for the canal children: a coarse undyed long-sleeved shirt with the sleeves rolled, a clay-smeared leather apron, the old belt, soft boots. He holds a small fired clay horn, painted bright red and gold, up against one of his own horn stumps as a joke, a broad grin.
battle: Holding back the molten tide, in the finest fire-proof harness of the canal, worn plain: the broad-shouldered vest remade in layered scales of black volcanic glass sewn on fire-felt, their seams glowing ember red; plain ember-lit black iron guards on the shoulders and forearms; the old leather belt with the chipped clay cup at his hip; heat-scorched boots. He thrusts both open hands forward, a towering crown of red-gold flame branches rising from between the two black horn stumps and arching overhead, the dark red flame patterns on his arms blazing, the yellow eyes burning, the jaw set; heat shimmer and floating sparks wrap his whole body.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and immovable, the feet wide and planted, both open hands thrust forward as if pushing back a wall of fire, a crown of red-gold flame rising from between the two horn stumps; he carries no weapon.
formal: At the well cut with the two horn marks, on the night of the empty bowls: a long plain black wool coat of the western cut closing down the front with dark horn buttons, a dark red sash, the old belt with the clay cup, polished boots. He stands upright with the hands folded in front, a quiet, solemn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the yellow eyes looking down into his cupped palm, where a tiny carved bone dragon sits beside the chipped clay cup, a faint gold flame flickering between the two horn stumps. Warm molten orange light from below on one side, cold night blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks, the stone rim of a well cut with two horn marks and shards of black glassy rock.
gear: 传奇（约935年到传奇，这一百年是撼世）｜中｜朴素｜5档｜这一页他是撼世的传奇，家境不再算，写这一纪顶上的气势；他一辈子是渠上干活的人，穿耐火背心，传奇那一身照最好的料子做、样子还是干活的那一身，不加装饰。不拿兵器，招牌是两截角桩之间长出的焰冠和那只缺口陶杯。

name: 芭鲁娜
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_一_探井的年月.md:3093
who: Baruna, called the Hands Under the Bridge, a demon of the forge-hell clan from the Dorkan camp, who gives her camp's name and never a family name; a legend whose name took hold in 626 at thirty-six, still looking to be in her twenties, three hundred and fifty-eight in the year 2: about 191 cm, tall and heavily built. Deep bronze skin, her clan's own colour. Red-tinged black hair braided flat to the head in short tight braids. Amber eyes and short, hard, dark red horns sweeping back. Both palms burnt black since the bridge, the backs of her hands unmarked. No jewellery. A gentle, careful giant who keeps telling people to slow down, and who tucks a black hand into her sleeve when someone stares at it.
build: 191 cm, tall and powerfully built: thick shoulders and back, solid legs, a C-cup, a firm waist and broad hips.
palette: deep bronze, ember red, soot black, amber, ash white
casual: Her heavy-work clothes, much as they have been for three centuries: a worn dark leather jerkin over a long-sleeved coarse rust-red shirt with deep cuffs, a heavy leather work apron, wide dark trousers tucked into hobnailed boots, the iron camp tag stamped with the Dorkan mark on a cord at her throat; a coil of lifting rope over one shoulder. She stands with one black hand tucked half into the opposite sleeve, a shy, gentle look.
private: A loose long-sleeved undyed wool tunic and a rust-red wrap skirt over leggings, soft hide boots. She holds a stub of charcoal between two black fingers, looking at it, a quiet, wondering look.
battle: Bearing up a falling span, in the heaviest war plate of the western wall, made for her alone: a cuirass of black iron plates overlapping like stacked bridge stones over the leather jerkin, their seams glowing ember red; massive layered pauldrons shaped like keystones; forearm guards of black iron etched with ember runes that stop at the wrist so both burnt-black palms stay bare; heavy tassets in place of the apron; the iron camp tag worn outside the gorget; hobnailed iron-shod boots. She carries no weapon. Both black palms are raised at shoulder height as if bearing up a stone arch, white-hot light seeping from the lines of the palms and a vast faint shape of a burning arch glowing above her hands, a calm, intent face.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced like a pillar, the feet wide and planted, both black palms raised at shoulder height as if bearing up a great stone arch, white-hot light in the lines of the palms; she carries no weapon.
formal: At a truce gathering on the south wall: a clean long dark red wool coat buttoned to the throat, a short black cloak, black trousers and polished boots, the iron camp tag worn outside the collar. She stands straight with her black palms hidden in her sleeves, the tips of her ears faintly red.
art: A tilted portrait, the face large, lit from below by white fire, both black palms lifted near the edge of the frame as if bearing something enormous, the amber eyes resting on the viewer, steady and kind. Hot white-orange light from below, cool dusk blue from above. Foreground blur: sparks, a stone bridge arch with two black handprints and a few childish charcoal marks beside them.
gear: 传奇（这一百年是撼世）｜贫｜不靠兵器｜5档｜山铜纪那一版是626年凝名那一回、估灵格、一档的捡来甲；到迷宫纪2年她早已是撼世的传奇，家境不再算，写这一纪顶上的气势。她只拿身子扛东西，不拿兵器，甲照西边墙上最重的黑铁做、量身打，护臂到腕为止，两只烧黑的掌心照旧露着。

name: 博尔卡·血纹
src: 迷宫纪前传/补卷/补卷_84_大敌线与沉灯会.md:146
who: Borka Redmark, an old fire-horn demon-kin general of the west who has fought below this stretch of the Long Wall since the days of the old high thrones, leader of the war band the border troops call the Red-Line Tent; he looks about sixty, NOT young: a head taller than other fire-horns, about 215 cm, broad-backed and heavy. Dark crimson skin, the fire-horn colour, layered with old scars one over another. A cropped iron-white mane. Molten-gold eyes. Two horns curling back; the left horn (on the viewer's right when he faces us) broken off partway. Both horns carry painted dark red mourning lines in the old high-throne custom, drawn for the dead, the line on the broken end drawn deepest. No earrings, no other jewellery. Gruff, grim and unbending; he speaks of the dead as if they were still in his tent.
face: FACE, as in the references: an old fire-horn warrior's face of about sixty, broad and heavy-boned, NOT young: deep lines across the brow and beside the mouth, old scars crossing the cheek and jaw; molten-gold eyes under a heavy brow; a grim, set mouth. Skin shadows a soft warm red-brown.
build: about 215 cm, a head taller than other fire-horns: a very broad back and shoulders, thick arms, heavy-built.
palette: dark crimson, iron white, molten gold, black iron, painted dark red
casual: His old general's dress: a long heavy black wool coat of the western cut with the collar turned up, much mended and lined in faded dark red, worn open over a black leather jerkin; a broad belt, dark trousers tucked into heavy old boots; a small copper contract-number plate on the left shoulder. He holds the long-handled axe with its leather-wrapped haft upright beside him, the broad head above his shoulder. A grim, heavy look.
private: In his tent at night: a coarse dark red wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up the scarred forearms, thick wool wraps bound round both legs from ankle to knee, which are always cold at night, dark trousers, soft boots. He holds a lantern in one hand and a rolled hand-drawn map of old tunnels in the other, a brooding look.
battle: Holding the breach on the west rim, in the old war harness of the high-throne years, kept and re-forged: a heavy black iron cuirass and gorget over the leather jerkin, ember-lit black iron guards on the shoulders and forearms with seams glowing dull red, a small copper contract-number plate riveted to the left pauldron, a scorched long black war cloak, heavy plated boots. Both hands grip the long leather-wrapped axe, its broad head raised and angled across his body, a seam of molten orange running along the edge; both horns blazing up into two tall pillars of fire, the painted dark red lines glowing on them, the molten-gold eyes hard.
formal: Before the Broken Gate on the third day of the talks: the long black wool coat buttoned to the throat with dark horn buttons, a dark red sash, black gloves, the dark red mourning lines freshly painted on both horns, the old boots polished; no blade at his belt. He stands upright with the hands clasped behind him, a cold, unyielding look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the molten-gold eyes looking down at the viewer, the painted dark red line on the broken horn catching the light. Hot red firelight from below on one side, cold night blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting embers, a frayed length of rope and the leather-wrapped haft of the axe.
gear: 英雄｜中｜照常（守旧）｜4档｜补卷写他到死是英雄，英雄不看家境，用量身打的战装；他是旧高座那时候的老将，守旧高座描纹的规矩，甲是那时候打的、往后一再重锻的黑铁重甲，西边边军的铜号牌钉在左肩，兵器照页上那柄缠皮的长柄斧。画的是97年西沿缺口那一夜，两只角烧成两柱火。

name: 织麻的妇人
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_一_探井的年月.md:3188
who: A woman of the Schwab family from the village below the Wall, a flax weaver of about thirty, whose husband, a soldier in the gun fort on the east rim of the pit, did not come out of the first tide; she has a little daughter of four. About 163 cm, slender but work-strong. Honey-blonde hair pinned up under a plain linen kerchief, a few strands loose at the temples. Cornflower-blue eyes. A light dusting of freckles across the nose. Fair skin. No jewellery. A quiet, steady, ordinary air; when the crowd at the gate panics, she is the one who says the plain thing out loud.
build: about 163 cm, slender but work-strong, with firm forearms from the loom and a modest figure.
palette: undyed flax, honey blonde, cornflower blue, faded madder red, worn brown
casual: Her village weaver's clothes: a faded undyed linen dress with long sleeves, the skirt hitched up and tucked into her belt at one side for work, a brown wool vest laced over it, a coarse apron with flax fibres caught in it, a linen kerchief over the pinned hair, boots mended three times. She holds a hand distaff wound with grey flax, a calm, tired look.
private: A plain long-sleeved linen shift under a knitted brown shawl, the hair loose in a long plait, soft shoes. She holds a small brass soldier's coat button in her palm, looking down at it, a still, quiet look.
battle: Crowding into the West Gate in the first tide: the linen dress with the skirt tucked up, the brown wool vest, a heavy grey wool cloak thrown over everything, the kerchief pulled down, the mended boots, a small bundle tied at her back.
battle_pose: 3) the field outfit: one arm raised high as she calls out, the other hand clutching the edge of the cloak at her chest, the head turned back over her shoulder, a fierce, hopeful look; she carries no weapon.
formal: In her best: a clean dark blue wool dress with long sleeves closing down the front with small horn buttons, a white linen collar folded down, a fresh white kerchief, the mended boots blacked; the small brass coat button on a red cord at her throat. She stands upright with the hands folded in front, a shy, solemn look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue eyes looking back over her shoulder at a distant line of torches on a hill, the mouth open on a call, the kerchief slipping. Red torchlight from one side, cold dusk blue on the other. Foreground blur: a small child's hand gripping the edge of her shawl, drifting ash and the grey stones of a gate wall.
gear: 凡人（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜墙下村织麻的妇人，不打仗，第三格写 battle_pose（潮那一天挤进西门、九日在墙头上喊守井的还站着呢），衣裳照探井的年月的平民，外头加一件厚斗篷，不加甲。
